description: Its 'good' verdict is provisional until the Elixir side is as fast as we can make it. Ideas: Output as one packed binary/iodata instead of two float lists (where most of Elixir's time goes); batch several windows per recursion step. Measure alternatives and record them in the example header; set baseline: :optimized when done. If Elixir comes within 2x, the verdict becomes marginal and Elixir is the recommendation: record that as a result.

comments.text: Lowered to P3 by 'Choose the target workload set' (defk-dtw.5): this is now a supporting example and doesn't count towards the verdict.

title: Optimise the Elixir baseline: rolling_stats
